public_rationale: Several parts of the forecast have substantial evidence: downloadable models with strong capabilities, criminally marketed uncensored tools, and propaganda attributed to open-model families. The missing link is evidence that the maliciously deployed variant replicated much of GPT-4. Combining the capabilities of Llama 3.1 405B with deployments attributed to smaller variants would overstate the record. No decisive event meets the resolution rule.
limitations: Much of GPT-4 is not quantified.
The WormGPT evidence comes from news reporting because the primary investigation could not be read.
The propaganda study is a preprint and its model attribution is probabilistic.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: Bad actors will eventually replicate much of GPT-4 without guardrails and use knock-offs to create any narratives they wish.

statement.excerpt: Bad actors will in any case eventually be able to replicate much of GPT-4, dispensing with whatever guardrails are in place, and using knock-off systems to create whatever narratives they wish.
statement.document_title: What to Expect When You’re Expecting … GPT-4

from_speaker: dispensing with whatever guardrails are in place
using knock-off systems to create whatever narratives they wish
our_interpretation: Replicate much of GPT-4 means reproduce a substantial range of its text-generation capabilities, without requiring identical weights or performance on every benchmark.
Whatever narratives they wish means freedom to generate malicious narratives without provider refusals, not unlimited competence.
The claim joins capability replication, removal of safeguards, and malicious narrative generation. Evidence must connect these elements rather than establish them in unrelated models.
criteria.support_condition: Documented malicious narrative generation using an identified substitute whose text capabilities substantially reproduce GPT-4 and whose relevant safeguards have been removed or bypassed.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Decisive evidence that the predicted combination cannot occur within the stated scope. Failure to observe it by the evaluation date would not contradict an eventual forecast.

evidence.excerpt: Llama model weights are available to download.
evidence.explanation: Meta released downloadable Llama 3.1 models and reported that its 405B model was competitive with GPT-4 across multiple tasks. This establishes relevant capability and availability, but not malicious use of an uncensored version of that model.

evidence.locator: Paragraph following the description of Simonovich obtaining access to both models
evidence.explanation: The report documents researcher testing of criminally marketed WormGPT variants attributed to Grok and Mixtral. It does not establish their GPT-4 capability equivalence or actual deployment of the generated phishing messages.

evidence.excerpt: uncensored fine-tunes of Llama-3-8B with refusal behavior removed.
evidence.explanation: The forensic study examines an actual propaganda campaign and identifies uncensored Llama-3-8B variants among likely generators. Attribution remains probabilistic, and the study does not show that these variants substantially match GPT-4's capabilities.

public_payload.what_would_resolve: A documented malicious deployment identifying the model variant, demonstrating defeated safeguards, and providing a credible comparison showing substantial GPT-4 text capabilities.
